author: Veopth
body:
Hello,

i want to show you some thing that i want to get change in this map.

  1. Wool Room Size



  • When you are on the wool room the enemies can shoot you very easy, and you dont have gapples or nothing to heal, so, if its a match with campers, gg. btw, you cant place block in the wool room.
  • Getting out the wool its hard too, cause if you are alone in the wool room and there are like 3 camping its impossible to get out with half life... 

  1. Wool Room Loot




  • there's only one wool chest, and you dont have gapples / armor / bow, you only get wools, and according to the woolr room size, you die easily.

Thanks, hope you change this things!
